error.message:
Expected upstream_failure: R odbc ignores fail_if_missing=FALSE when generating DROP TABLE. Reference: https://github.com/r-dbi/odbc/blob/v1.4.2/R/dbi-table.R. Reproducer: repros/r-contract.R.
Reported FAILED: `dbRemoveTable(con, table_name, fail_if_missing = FALSE)` threw an unexpected error.
Message: nanodbc/nanodbc.cpp:1710: 00000
Base table or view not found: <main>: Error: Type annotation, code: 1030
    <main>:5:13: Error: At function: KiDropTable!
        <main>:5:13: Error: Cannot find table 'db.[/local/dbitbxtfuhnygt]' because it does not exist or you do not have access permissions. Please check correctness of table path and user permissions., code: 2003
 
Class:   nanodbc::database_error/C++Error/error/condition
